messages:
Alex: Quick sync — need a decision on the chat endpoint shape for next quarter. Field requests: (A) canonical messages array with {role,content,meta} and (B) a simple `prompt` string mode for legacy integrators. Which do we prioritize? Launch criteria?

Priya: From product POV: customers want a predictable migration path. Propose default -> messages array; add `compatibility_mode: "prompt"` optional. Launch criteria: SDK adapters, migration guide, e2e tests + latency regression <5% p50.

Mark: Eng notes: messages array is cleaner for function calling and structured outputs. Prompt string mode is easy but loses role semantics. Cost: two codepaths + SDK transforms. Perf: parse overhead negligible. Risk: SDK parity.

Sam: ML: Messages lets us enforce `system` role and role-aware heuristics. Better for evals. For structured outputs we need `response_schema` support. If we add prompt mode, auto-wrap into messages with best-effort role inference.

Ellie: Sales: Several enterprise customers asked for prompt string to avoid refactoring. They'll accept an SDK shim but need timeline <=8w.

Alex: Tradeoff: messages-first, prompt-shim opt-in; must support function-calling and structured output in both modes. Rollout plan?

Mark: Rollout plan:
1) implement messages-only in hosted
2) build SDK shims (node/python) to convert prompt->messages
3) beta with pro customers
4) GA with migration docs. ETA: runtime 6w + SDK 3w + docs 2w = ~11w.

Priya: Launch checklist (short): SDK adapters, unit tests for role preservation, function-calling parity, structured-output schema enforcement, telemetry for prompt-mode errors, acceptance by 2 reference customers.

Sam: Add quality gate: prompt-mode must not increase hallucination rate >2% on our evals.

Alex: Action items: Mark owns runtime + rollout; Sam defines eval; Priya coordinates ref customers (Ellie to nominate); SDK leads start shims. Tracking: RD-1543. @Mark confirm ETA?

Mark: Confirming ~11w. I'll draft RFC and link RD-1543. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: RD-1543 created, owner set to Mark. (automated)

Alex: Locking messages-array-first, optional prompt compatibility shim as milestone 2. Thanks all.
